protocol.name: zxr_workspace_v1
protocol.description:
This protocol extends ext-workspace-v1 with the spatial properties of places and their reference frames: place kind, anchoring, pose and bounds, previews, per-consumer currency, and continuous switch transitions. It adds no workspace lifecycle of its own; grouping, activation, and enumeration remain ext-workspace-v1's.
A workspace group corresponds to a reference frame; the frame extension names its type and identity. ext_workspace_handle_v1.assign moves a place between frames. Workspace coordinates remain opaque sort keys; spatial poses travel only through this extension.
The key words "must", "must not", "required", "shall", "shall not", "should", "should not", "recommended", "may", and "optional" in this document are to be interpreted as described in IETF RFC 2119.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the experimental phase. Backward incompatible changes may be added without bumping the major version of the extension. As such, gating usage on the protocol's presence is discouraged outside spatial-os itself.

interface.name: zxr_workspace_manager_v1
interface.description:
The entry point for spatial workspace state. It extends workspaces and workspace groups obtained from ext_workspace_manager_v1, advertises the compositor's optional capabilities, and reports continuous transitions between places.
Transition events form their own batch: a sequence of transition events for one switch is opened by transition_started and closed by transition_ended; the events reference zxr_place_v1 objects, which remain valid for the duration of the batch (the compositor ends a transition batch before the referenced place becomes inert).

entry.name: already_extended
entry.summary: the workspace or group already has an extension object

enum.name: capability
enum.description: Optional capabilities of the compositor. Requests that require an absent capability are ignored; clients should hide or disable the UI elements that depend on them.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager. Existing extension objects are not affected.

request.name: get_place

description.summary: extend a workspace with spatial state

request.description: Create a zxr_place_v1 object extending the given workspace. A workspace may be extended at most once per client; a second request raises the already_extended error. If the workspace has already been removed upstream, the returned object is immediately inert (see zxr_place_v1).

request.name: get_frame

description.summary: extend a workspace group with frame identity

request.description: Create a zxr_frame_v1 object extending the given workspace group. A group may be extended at most once per client; a second request raises the already_extended error. If the group has already been removed upstream, the returned object is immediately inert (see zxr_frame_v1).

event.name: capabilities
event.description: The manager's capabilities. Sent on bind and whenever they change. The compositor will ignore requests it doesn't support.

event.name: transition_started
event.description: A continuous switch — a physical walk or an animated move — began between two places. Discrete switches send no transition events.

event.name: transition
event.description: Progress of the transition opened by the last transition_started event, from 0 at the source to 1 at the destination. Progress may move backwards.

event.name: transition_ended
event.description: The open transition ended, whether completed or abandoned. The final activation state is conveyed by ext-workspace-v1, not by this event; this batch is ordered before the upstream ext_workspace_manager_v1.done event that reports the resulting activation.

interface.name: zxr_frame_v1

description.summary: frame identity of a workspace group

interface.description:
The reference-frame identity of one workspace group. State events are followed by done; this allows changes to the frame state to be seen as atomic, even if they happen via multiple events.
When the underlying workspace group is removed upstream, the compositor will immediately consider this object inert. Any requests will be ignored except the destroy request; there won't be any more events referencing this object.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the extension object. The underlying group is not affected.

event.name: label
event.description: A human-readable label for the frame ("Kitchen", "Left wrist"). Labels are informational and may change; they carry no identity.

event.name: done

description.summary: the frame state batch is complete

event.description: Ends a frame state batch. This allows changes to the frame state to be seen as atomic, even if they happen via multiple events.

interface.name: zxr_place_v1
interface.description:
The spatial state of one workspace. State events are followed by a done event; this allows changes to the place state to be seen as atomic, even if they happen via multiple events.
Poses are given in the compositor's local reference space: metres, y up, right-handed; matrices are column-major arrays of 16 IEEE 754 binary32 values in native endianness.
When the underlying workspace is removed upstream, the compositor will immediately consider this object inert. Any requests will be ignored except the destroy request; there won't be any more events referencing this object. A preview capture source obtained from this object remains a valid protocol object; capture sessions on it fail with the capture protocol's stopped/failure semantics once the place is gone.

entry.name: not_pinnable
entry.summary: pin or rename requested on an overlay place

enum.name: kind
enum.description: The lifecycle kind of the place. A transient place exists only while it has members; a pinned place is a persistent named object that may be empty; an overlay place is attached to a body-relative frame and never competes for location-derived currency.

enum.name: anchor_state
enum.description: Whether the place's pose is bound to a persistent spatial anchor and whether that anchor is currently resolved. A pending anchor is persisted but not yet relocalized; its pose is the last known one and may change once, without animation, upon resolution.

enum.name: currency
enum.description: The decomposed currency of the place. located: the user's position is inside the place's volume. presented: the place is currently presented away from its home pose (summoned). The pager-active state remains ext-workspace-v1's active state and is not repeated here.

entry.name: located
entry.summary: the user is inside the place

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the extension object. The underlying workspace is not affected. Preview sources created from this object are not affected.

request.name: pin
request.description: Ask the compositor to make the place persistent under the given name. Requires the pin capability; without it the request is ignored. There is no guarantee that the place will be pinned; the result is conveyed through the kind event. Pinning an overlay place raises the not_pinnable error.

request.name: rename
request.description: Ask the compositor to rename a pinned place. Requires the rename capability; without it the request is ignored. There is no guarantee that the place will be renamed; the result is conveyed through ext_workspace_handle_v1.name. Renaming an overlay place raises the not_pinnable error; renaming a transient place is ignored.

request.name: get_preview
request.description: Create an image capture source whose content is a compositor-rendered preview of the place, for pagers and overviews. The source behaves as an ext_image_capture_source_v1 for use with ext_image_copy_capture_manager_v1, and remains valid independently of this object's lifetime.

event.name: anchor_id
event.description: The opaque identifier of the place's persistent anchor, stable across sessions for as long as the anchor exists. Sent only for anchored places; an empty string reports anchor removal.

event.name: pose
event.description: The transform from the place's local space to the compositor's local reference space, at the place's home pose. While the place is summoned (currency presented), the presentation pose differs; this event continues to carry the home pose.

event.name: bounds
event.description: Half-extents from the place origin along its local axes, in metres.

event.name: entry_policy

description.summary: whether the place has an entry policy

event.description: Whether an entry policy is configured. The policy's contents are configuration, not protocol.

event.name: done

description.summary: all pending place state has been sent

event.description: Ends a place state batch. This allows changes to the place state to be seen as atomic, even if they happen via multiple events.
